purpose: Document first-party local land-record context and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: The official district page links Tamil Nadu land e-services for Patta, FMB/Chitta/TSLR and A-Register extracts. The official Tamil Nadu GIS/TamilNilam material describes cadastral-boundary integration and land-map access, but no anonymous safe citywide parcel-vector endpoint was exposed in this bounded review. The VOC Port Authority public map exposes an anonymous GeoServer WFS, schema, CRS and geometry response for port-estate layers only.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official district page links public Tamil Nadu land e-services including Patta, FMB/Chitta/TSLR, A-Register and Poramboke verification.
Official TNGIS portal describes Tamil Nadu spatial-data services and cautions that public GIS data is informational and dynamically maintained.
Official Tamil Nadu e-governance material describes geo-referenced cadastral boundaries linked with TamilNilam and the TamilNilam Geo-Info app.
Government of India V.O. Chidambaranar Port Authority public Web GIS for port land; local map scope is port estate, not citywide cadastre.

attempts.result: Timed out after 20 seconds; no JavaScript/configuration or API response was obtained. This is an unavailable route, not evidence of absence.
Timed out after 15 seconds; no login was attempted and no response was retained.
Official public Web GIS loaded. Its JavaScript configuration identifies WMS/WFS workspace voc_port_survey and map projection EPSG:3857.

Anonymous WFS capabilities returned port-estate layers and WGS84 bounding boxes; layers include notallotted_notused, notallotted_usedbyport and lease_land_court. This is a port-authority estate dataset, not a citywide cadastral registry.

Schema returned gid and the_geom (gml:MultiSurfacePropertyType), with additional unsafe owner/lease fields observed but not requested or retained. Default SRS in capabilities is urn:x-ogc:def:crs:EPSG:3857.
Bounded geometry-only exact-WUP-point-area request returned an empty FeatureCollection. No geometry retained; zero hit is not citywide absence evidence.
Broader bounded query returned port-estate MultiPolygon features, but the response is outside a verified citywide cadastral scope and was not retained as a city sample.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Empty response from port-estate layer at the exact WUP point-area query; not evidence of citywide absence.

remainingUncertainty: The public Tamil Nadu cadastral map/API route, its exact schema/CRS and parcel coverage at the WUP point remain unverified because TNGIS and e-services routes timed out and no safe citywide vector endpoint was exposed.
